objective_pt: Dar uma opinião com nuance sobre um tema social (redes sociais, trabalho remoto, cidades), pesando os dois lados.

teacher.goal_pt: Puxar opiniões rápidas sobre temas do dia a dia e observar como o aluno começa uma opinião.
prompts: Is social media good or bad for us?
Would you prefer to work from home forever?
watchFor: Dizer "depends of"; o certo é "depends on".

exercises.prompt: It depends on how you use it, to be honest.
accepted: It depends on how you use it, to be honest.
To be honest, it depends on how you use it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês é "depend on", não "depend of".
commonErrors.correction_en: It depends on how you use it.

exercises.instruction_pt: "Atualmente, muita gente trabalha de casa." Which word means "atualmente"?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Actually" significa "na verdade", e "eventually" significa "no fim, com o tempo". "Atualmente" é "nowadays" ou "currently".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Atualmente, as pessoas passam tempo demais no celular."
accepted: Nowadays, people spend too much time on their phones
Nowadays, people spend too much time on their phone
These days, people spend too much time on their phones
Currently, people spend too much time on their phones
Today, people spend too much time on their phones
Nowadays people spend way too much time on their phones
People spend too much time on their phones nowadays
People spend too much time on their phones these days
Nowadays, people spend too much time on their cell phones
Nowadays, people spend too much time on their mobile phones

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Actually" é "na verdade". Para "atualmente", use "nowadays", "these days" or "currently".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays, people spend too much time on their phones.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ao falar de pessoas em geral, não use "the": "people spend", e não "the people spend".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays, people spend too much time on their phones.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Usamos "on" com telefone e telas: "on their phones".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays, people spend too much time on their phones.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender expressões para opinar e pesar argumentos: on the one hand, the downside, I'd argue that, to some extent.
prompts: What's the biggest downside of living in a big city?
To what extent do you agree that money brings happiness?
watchFor: Dizer "in the other hand"; o certo é "on the other hand".
Usar "I think that" em toda frase; variar com "In my view", "I'd say".

exercises.example_en: Cities have more jobs. On the other hand, life is more expensive.
The main downside of remote work is loneliness.
I agree with you to some extent.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Say it in English: "Eu concordo com você até certo ponto."
accepted: I agree with you to some extent
I agree with you to a certain extent
To some extent, I agree with you
To a certain extent, I agree with you
I agree with you up to a point
I partly agree with you
I agree with you to a point
I kind of agree with you

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Agree" já é verbo: "I agree". "I am agree" é tradução de "estou de acordo".
commonErrors.correction_en: I agree with you to some extent.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Até certo ponto" é "to some extent", "to a certain extent" ou "up to a point".
commonErrors.correction_en: I agree with you to some extent.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a ênfase contrastiva ("ON the one hand... on the OTHER hand") e o som de "th" em "the other".
prompts: Say "on the other hand". Where does your voice go up?
watchFor: Trocar o "th" de "the other" por "d" ("de oder").
Falar todas as palavras com o mesmo peso, sem contraste.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. Stress "OTHER" and put your tongue between your teeth for "th".
exercises.prompt: On the other hand, it brings people together.
accepted: On the other hand, it brings people together.

exercises.prompt: It isn't good or bad in itself; it depends on how we use it.
accepted: It isn't good or bad in itself; it depends on how we use it.
It's not good or bad in itself, it depends on how we use it.
It is not good or bad in itself, it depends on how we use it.

exercises.instruction_pt: In "I didn't say SHE was wrong", what does the stress suggest?
options: Someone else was wrong, not her.
I wrote it, I didn't say it.
exercises.explanation_pt: A ênfase muda o sentido: com força em "SHE", a ideia é que outra pessoa estava errada.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender opiniões com nuance e identificar a posição real de quem fala.
prompts: Do you think public transport should be free?
What are the pros and cons?
watchFor: Achar que "I see your point, but..." é concordância total.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. What is the speaker's opinion?
exercises.listen: I can see why people like remote work, but personally, I think we lose a lot when we never meet face to face.
options: Remote work has an important downside.
exercises.explanation_pt: "I can see why..., but personally I think..." reconhece o outro lado e depois mostra a opinião: perdemos algo sem contato presencial.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. Give your opinion: say it depends.
exercises.listen: Do you think social media is bad for teenagers?
accepted: It depends
I think it depends
It depends on how they use it
I think it depends on how they use it
It depends on how much they use it
In my view, it depends on how they use it
To some extent, but it depends on how they use it
It can be, but it depends on how they use it
Not necessarily, it depends on how they use it
It depends on the person
Well, it depends

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês é "depend on": "It depends on how they use it".
commonErrors.correction_en: It depends on how they use it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Numa resposta completa, o inglês pede o sujeito: "It depends on...".
commonErrors.correction_en: It depends on how they use it.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. Partly agree, then add a "but".
exercises.listen: Big cities are much better places to live than small towns.
accepted: I agree to some extent, but small towns are safer
I agree to some extent, but they're more expensive
That's true to some extent, but small towns are calmer
I see your point, but small towns are quieter
I see your point, but life is more expensive in big cities
Up to a point, but small towns are safer
To some extent, but big cities are more stressful
I partly agree, but small towns are safer
Maybe, but small towns have a better quality of life
That's true in some ways, but big cities are more stressful
I agree up to a point, but big cities are expensive

commonErrors.correction_en: I partly agree, but small towns are safer.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Adjetivos curtos formam o comparativo com "-er": "calmer", "safer", "quieter".
commonErrors.correction_en: I agree to some extent, but small towns are safer.

teacher.goal_pt: Debater um tema social leve, dando opinião, um exemplo e reconhecendo o outro lado.
prompts: Should the working week be four days?
What would be the upside and the downside?
watchFor: Generalizar com "the people", "the society"; em inglês é "people", "society".
Dizer "everybody have"; "everybody" pede verbo no singular: "everybody has".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "A sociedade precisa levar a saúde mental mais a sério."
accepted: Society needs to take mental health more seriously
Society has to take mental health more seriously
Society should take mental health more seriously
Society must take mental health more seriously
We as a society need to take mental health more seriously
As a society, we need to take mental health more seriously

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ao falar da sociedade em geral, não use "the": "Society needs to...".
commonErrors.correction_en: Society needs to take mental health more seriously.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Aqui precisamos do advérbio: "take something more seriously" (com -ly).
commonErrors.correction_en: Society needs to take mental health more seriously.
Society needs to take mental health more seriously.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Por um lado, é mais barato; por outro lado, é menos confortável."
accepted: On the one hand, it's cheaper; on the other hand, it's less comfortable
On one hand, it's cheaper; on the other hand, it's less comfortable
On the one hand, it's cheaper, but on the other hand, it's less comfortable
On one hand it's cheaper, but on the other it's less comfortable
On the one hand it's cheaper, on the other it's less comfortable
On the one hand, it's less expensive; on the other hand, it's less comfortable

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão usa "on": "on the one hand... on the other hand".
commonErrors.correction_en: On the one hand, it's cheaper; on the other hand, it's less comfortable.
On the one hand, it's cheaper.

exercises.instruction_pt: Put the words in order to give a balanced opinion.
accepted: I see your point but I'd argue that it's more complicated

exercises.instruction_pt: Give your opinion on the question. Show both sides before you conclude.
exercises.prompt_en: Some people say that working from home is the future and offices will disappear. What's your view?
guidelines_pt: Give your opinion: "In my view..." or "I'd argue that..."
Show both sides: "On the one hand... On the other hand..."
Give an example and conclude: "So overall, I think..."

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar as expressões de opinião e os erros com "the" em generalizações.
prompts: Is technology making us more or less social?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Na minha visão, a educação é a chave para reduzir a desigualdade."
accepted: In my view, education is the key to reducing inequality
In my opinion, education is the key to reducing inequality
In my view, education is key to reducing inequality
In my view, education is the key to reduce inequality
The way I see it, education is the key to reducing inequality
I think education is the key to reducing inequality
In my view, education is the key to reducing social inequality

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Educação em geral não leva "the": "education is the key".
commonErrors.correction_en: In my view, education is the key to reducing inequality.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Dizemos "the key to" algo: "the key to reducing inequality".
commonErrors.correction_en: In my view, education is the key to reducing inequality.
Education is the key to reducing inequality.

exercises.sentence: Everybody ___ an opinion about politics these days.
accepted: has

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Everybody" e "everyone" pedem o verbo no singular: "everybody has".
commonErrors.correction_en: Everybody has an opinion about politics these days.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which phrase shows you only partly agree?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Up to a point" é "até certo ponto". "Absolutely" e "Exactly" mostram concordância total.

exercises.prompt: So, all things considered, I think it does more good than harm.
accepted: So, all things considered, I think it does more good than harm.
All things considered, I think it does more good than harm.
